So a bit ago I posted a link to my comic book series where my name comes from, but before reading the group rules in regards to content restrictions. Ended up deleting it. 
I am the creator, artist and writer for The Changeling. Book's been on hiatus for a few years now since I'm going through some cancer BS. Here's a link to some of my artwork both colored and lineart: https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/wtvnffvc10xzhbrv0n7vp/APu1V7Fc7V1dzOANRj2ufZE?rlkey=ymbrkrx4rtfyn5ywz04pqo7pm&st=dj3202t7&dl=0

If you're interested and it's not in violation of TOS, message me and I'll give ya a free digital copy of the series up until I stopped!
